items.title: Roy Carew Interview, 1964-11-28
items.q: Is J. Lawrence Cook still in the business? Yeah, he's still up there. He must be getting right old.

ctx.x: Piano. Well, he did the following verses of those vulgar verses. Is J. Lawrence Cook still in the business? Yeah, he's still up there. He must be getting right old. He's for himself right now. He's not with the QRS? No. I don't know when they're still going or not to know. Courtlander died.
